name: Parmesan-Crusted Baked Salmon with Rice and Green Beans

components.name: Parmesan-Crusted Salmon

ingredients.name: Olive oil to bind crumb topping

steps: Heat oven to 200 C, pat salmon dry and arrange on a lined tray.
Mix breadcrumbs, parmesan, pesto, oil, herbs and lemon to a damp crumb consistency; press over the flesh side of salmon.
Roast for 12-18 minutes until salmon centre reaches 63 C and crumb top is golden; adjust timing for thickness.
Divide crusted salmon with rice and green beans into five balanced meals; keep crisp topping dry when reheating.

components.name: Basmati Rice
steps: Rinse uncooked rice and simmer with measured water until tender, then rest covered.

components.name: Green Beans
steps: Roast or steam green beans with their measured oil and salt until just tender.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
This is an original UNHANGRY parmesan salmon variation informed by Good Food pesto and breadcrumb crusted fish, NOT an identical source recipe.
Planning: SECONDARY STOVETOP: rice; roast beans in same oven if space permits.
Freezer: salmon can freeze but crumb coating softens after thaw
Dietary: Fish, wheat, milk and possibly nuts from pesto.

Refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers at 4°C or colder, for 3–4 days at most, and follow the shorter seafood limit above. Cook fish and shellfish to 63°C and reheat leftovers to at least 74°C.

preservationAndReheating: Refrigerate cooked food promptly in shallow covered containers. Target within 2 hours, or 1 hour when ambient temperature exceeds 32 C.
Refrigerate at 4 C or below for 3-4 days maximum; freeze later-week portions soon after cooking.
Reheat cooked leftovers to 74 C. Cook fish and crustaceans to 63 C (145 F) or applicable local food-safety standard. Use a food thermometer.
When a recipe includes rice, cool it rapidly and store cold immediately; avoid leaving cooked rice at room temperature.
Freeze in suitable airtight food-safe containers. Defrost in refrigerator, not on counter. Reheat crisp foods in oven when possible.
